user.title: Stockpot
user.description: Connect a Stockpot household. « Sign in with Stockpot » opens Stockpot to choose the household and authorise Home Assistant (needs the My Home Assistant integration, part of default_config). « Manual token » uses a token with the « ha » ability created in Stockpot > Settings > Home Assistant.

data_description.verify_ssl: Disable only for a self-signed certificate on your network.
data_description.auth_method: Signing in with Stockpot is recommended: no token to copy, renewed automatically.

token.title: Manual token
token.description: Token with the « ha » ability for {url} (Stockpot > Settings > Home Assistant). The token is bound to one household.

data_description.token: Shown once when created in Stockpot.

household.title: Household
household.description: Choose the household to show in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The token of {url} no longer works. Create a new one with the « ha » ability.

reauth_oauth.title: Sign in again
reauth_oauth.description: Home Assistant no longer has access to {url} (access revoked, expired or account removed from the household). Sign in with Stockpot again.

reconfigure.title: Stockpot
reconfigure.description: Change the address, the token or the SSL check.

reconfigure_oauth.title: Stockpot
reconfigure_oauth.description: Change the address or the SSL check, then sign in with Stockpot again.

error.ssl_error: The TLS certificate of Stockpot was refused. Check the URL, or disable the SSL check for a self-signed certificate.
error.missing_ability: This token does not have the « ha » ability. Create one in Stockpot > Settings > Home Assistant.
error.two_factor_required: This household requires two-factor authentication: enable it on the token's account.
error.household_forbidden: This token is bound to another household, or the account is not a member of it.
error.not_stockpot: No Stockpot sign-in found at this address. Check the URL (e.g. https://stockpot.arakeo.com).
error.oauth_unsupported: This Stockpot does not offer Home Assistant sign-in yet: update it, or choose « Manual token ».
error.insecure_endpoint: This Stockpot is on https but advertises an http sign-in endpoint: refused (downgrade). Check its APP_URL.
error.http_public_host: Plain http is only accepted for a local address (loopback, private network, .local…). Use https.
error.my_required: The My Home Assistant integration is not enabled: Stockpot redirects to my.home-assistant.io after sign-in. Enable it (default_config or my:), or choose « Manual token ». If your Stockpot administrator added this Home Assistant's address to STOCKPOT_OAUTH_HA_REDIRECT_HOSTS, submit again to continue.

abort.wrong_instance: This token or account belongs to another Stockpot instance or household: add it as a new integration.
abort.two_factor_required: This household requires two-factor authentication: enable it on your Stockpot account.
